current_status_resolution.statement: Springboard Phase5 passed; platform/noise is blocked by validation design/gating, so global Phase5 is not yet pass-complete.

recovery_paths.name: track_level_acceptance
recovery_paths.description: Accept springboard as passed; mark platform/noise validation-blocked until valid scored slice exists.
recovery_paths.notes: Honest status framing now, but does not unblock global Phase5 pass/fail.

recovery_paths.name: build_new_scored_slice_from_existing_reviewed_data
recovery_paths.description: Materialize a valid two-class platform/noise scored validation slice from existing reviewed manifests.
recovery_paths.notes: Best immediate unblocker; requires explicit provenance and split-freeze update.

recovery_paths.name: minimal_additional_human_review_for_platform_noise_slice
recovery_paths.description: Add smallest targeted human review set to recover a clean two-class mixed validation slice.
recovery_paths.notes: Current reviewed Champigny set lacks non-ambiguous noise depth; would require new reviewed rows (not yet materialized).
recovery_paths.minimal_needed: at least 4-6 additional clean Champigny noise_or_other rows with proposal-centered/compatible context, plus 1-2 platform checks.

recovery_paths.name: protocol_revision_for_track_scored_vs_reporting_only
recovery_paths.description: Revise global Phase5 pass/fail rule when one track is scored and another is reporting-only.
recovery_paths.notes: Useful only after explicit governance decision; should not replace missing platform/noise scored validation evidence.

best_next_path.why: It is the fastest scientifically defensible route to restore a valid two-class platform/noise scored slice using already reviewed data, without relabeling or detector/model changes.
